articles.title: New Jersey homebuyer gets $575K home for $545K, saves $350 a month with incentives
articles.summary: A New Jersey homebuyer viewed 10 older houses but rejected them after finding costly repairs and maintenance would add to their purchase price. He then considered a new townhouse in Pennsylvania listed at $575,000. After negotiations, he bought it for $545,000 and secured $30,000 in builder incentives, including a mortgage-rate buydown that reduced his rate from 6.25% to 5.25%.

articles.title: Melting Norway ice reveals 48 prehistoric arrows up to 6,000 years old
articles.summary: In a remarkable discovery, Norwegian archaeologists are uncovering ancient treasures as glaciers shrink, revealing 48 prehistoric arrows, including one dated between 5,000 and 6,000 years. This influx of artefacts signifies a shift in our understanding of prehistoric activities as ice melts in the region. The urgency of recovery efforts underscores the impending deterioration of these valuable pieces, highlighting the rapid loss of ice cover around the world.

While the home offers significant size, much of the interior remains unfinished and requires renovation. Buyers should consider potential renovation costs alongside the low asking price per square foot. This property has potential for various uses, including a vacation home or rental.

articles.title: ‘My wife is ill, I want to sleep with you’: UP school operator's video goes viral
articles.summary: Dinesh Rai, a private school operator in Kushinagar, was arrested due to a viral video. The video showed him making inappropriate comments to a female staff member. Rai allegedly suggested a physical relationship while referencing personal issues. Following the video's circulation, police registered a case against him under various sections of the law. Further legal action will be determined based on ongoing investigations and available evidence.

articles.title: Martha Stewart bought 63-acre Maine estate for under $6m, restored historic home
articles.summary: In 1997, Martha Stewart took over the Skylands estate, diligently preserving its historic architecture and the stunning landscape, initially crafted by Jens Jensen. This remarkable property, once owned by Edsel Ford, encapsulates pivotal elements of American architectural history connected to the Ford lineage. With the help of landscape architect Patrick Chassé, Stewart revitalized the estate’s gardens to harmonize with the natural environment.

articles.title: Kevin O’Leary-backed Utah AI data center plan downsized after local backlash
articles.summary: Kevin O’Leary-backed plans for a 40,000-acre AI data centre district in Utah have been cut to about 20,000 acres after strong local opposition. Residents have raised concerns over the project’s energy and water use, environmental impact and public review. Developers say the project could create thousands of jobs and support US computing and national defence.

articles.title: Utah man built backyard railroad with 40,000 pounds of gravel and $18,000 budget
articles.summary: Cory Mohl from West Valley City has constructed a remarkable backyard railroad project, aiming to share his love for trains with the community. He dedicated significant time and resources to build around 400 feet of track, attracting local children who delight in riding the miniature train. This charming setup has become a beloved neighborhood fixture, encouraging connections among residents.

articles.title: Three golds in a day! Ankush completes Indian boxing hat-trick at Asian Games
articles.summary: Ankush Panghal secured the gold medal in the men's 80kg final against South Korea's Minseong Kim. This victory came after Lovlina Borgohain and Parveen Hooda won their respective finals in women's categories. Lovlina celebrated her birthday with a significant win against China's Ziyi Bao, becoming a two-time Asian Games champion. Parveen earned her first Asian Games gold in a tightly contested match against Chen Nien-chin of Chinese Taipei.

articles.title: Warring hints at Pilot’s role in Punjab Congress leadership change ahead of 2027 polls

The incident has led to significant changes at the ashram, including the suspension of initiation ceremonies and changes to disciples' dress codes. Visitors have reported being unable to meet with Premanand Maharaj due to these restrictions.

articles.title: ‘I wanted to quit boxing’: Lovlina fights through tough year to script historic gold
articles.summary: Lovlina Borgohain celebrated her 29th birthday by winning gold at the Asian Games in Japan. She had previously considered quitting boxing after a disappointing performance at the Paris Olympics. Overcoming self-doubt and a year of challenges, Lovlina triumphed in the women's 75kg final against China's Ziyi Bao. This victory also marked the end of a 12-year wait for a female boxing champion from India.

articles.title: 90 is a crowd: Not enough seats, teachers in Delhi govt schools
articles.summary: The overcrowding crisis in Delhi government schools has sparked alarm among education advocates and students alike. With some classes hosting as many as 90 students, the learning environment suffers drastically. The shortage of subject teachers in senior secondary classes only worsens the situation. The Delhi government aims to improve conditions through infrastructure expansion, but education activists stress that immediate action is essential to protect students' rights to quality education.

articles.title: Indianapolis man built $13m fortune; estate gave $1.6m to classroom charity
articles.summary: Terence Kahn, who lived a remarkably simple life, amassed over $13 million before his death in January 2021. After his passing, his estate representatives reached out to various nonprofits in Indianapolis to ensure his wealth was used for good. Among the beneficiaries, Teachers’ Treasures received an impactful donation of $1.6 million, which initiated the nonprofit's inaugural endowment fund and bolstered its mission to distribute essential supplies to teachers.

articles.title: Iowa carpenter left nearly $3m; 33 students he funded later gathered to honor him
articles.summary: An Iowa carpenter who never went to college quietly saved nearly $3 million during his 67-year career. After his death in 2005, the money funded college education for 33 students who could not otherwise afford it. Fourteen years later, the students, known as “Dale’s Kids”, gathered to remember the man they had never met.

articles.title: North Dakota couple saved 5 years, then transformed kitchen with $9,037 makeover
articles.summary: Megan and Jeff Hamann embarked on a creative journey to renovate their kitchen in two distinct phases. With a modest budget of under $10,000, they transitioned their once gaudy space into a charming farmhouse-style kitchen. The initial phase prioritized making the kitchen livable, followed by phase two, which included stylish upgrades like new countertops and lighting fixtures, culminating in a space that's both practical and picturesque.
